newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen continuing in tight range.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen continuing in tight range.

text.p: *Stocks to repeat tight range and narrow finish. "The softer sentiment from overseas only seems to last half a day and then we come back to buoyancy again," said a Brisbane-based broker.
*Wall Street posted modest losses after a session dominated by profit-taking, particularly among large-cap tech stocks.
*ADRs: News Corp 17-5/8 (+1/8), BHP 28-5/8 (+1/4), WMC 25-3/4 (-1/8), National Australia Bank 71-1/8 (-1/2)
*Gold price was firmer, on LME tin slumped to a two year low and most other metals finished lower but copper and zinc bounced from lows as speculative bulls kept faith in the uptrend.
